title: Docs match what check and the git allowlist do
lead: The architecture doc, the getting-started guide and the CI comment say `check` never runs git, and the architecture doc lists two git commands the allowlist does not have; both are corrected to match the code.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** any change to `check` or `vcs.py`; removing the git calls from `check` (the item "Fewer git calls per command" covers their cost).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The Go rewrite evaluation (`research/go-rewrite-evaluation.md`, merged 2026-10-15) found two places where the invariant docs that agents read disagree with the code. First, `ARCHITECTURE.md:266-267`, `docs/getting-started.md:911` and the comment at `.github/workflows/ci.yml:34` say `check` "never shells out to git". Since s301, `check.run` calls `_sibling_collisions` (`src/slicer/check.py:61`), which runs `vcs.is_repo`, `vcs.resolve`, `store.sibling_checkouts` and, when titles differ, `verify.inherited_ids` (`src/slicer/check.py:74-85`), all git subprocesses; the collision paragraph in `ARCHITECTURE.md` itself says so, so the document contradicts itself. Second, `ARCHITECTURE.md:195-196` lists `mv` and `ls-files` in `vcs.ALLOWED`, but the allowlist (`src/slicer/vcs.py:17-20`) has neither. Both drifts are in the safe direction, but these paragraphs document the git invariant and must be exact.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`: the "What `check` is" section says `check` runs read-only git calls only for the sibling-worktree collision warning, skipped outside a repository, and still writes nothing to git; the allowlist sentence names exactly the entries in `vcs.ALLOWED`.
- `docs/getting-started.md` (the CI section near line 911) and the comment in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: a shallow checkout is still fine, because a CI clone has no sibling worktrees; say that instead of "never shells out to git".
- `CHANGELOG.md` under Fixed (documentation).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - None required: a docs-only diff. If a test already pins the allowlist sentence or `ARCHITECTURE.md` text, update it; otherwise add `test_Architecture_AllowlistSentence_MatchesVcsAllowed` beside the existing docs tests, reading `ARCHITECTURE.md` and comparing the backticked names in the allowlist sentence with `vcs.ALLOWED`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Correct the three `check` statements and the allowlist sentence.
2. If the allowlist test is added, watch it go red before the doc fix and green after.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run` passes.
- `slicer check` passes; `git diff --check` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
